culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Eiko Ikeguchi. First, she stole Hayashida's weather balloon to get the crime scene by floating down via weather balloons. She used five of the six balloons. After the crime, she climbed up the mountain, she because she was rushing she ended up injuring her palm. And there are marks of the balloon and she also smelled of kerosene. Her motive was that Motoki was trying to find Takemi in the mountains by climbing down the cliff, without knowing that she was taking pictures below the mountain. Which inadvertently caused Motoki to fall from the cliff to his death. Eiko also confessed
